cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your fern's watered. Holiday duty complete. I taught you to ask for exactly what you need, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need every plant watered every day until Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're remembering quantities. One teaspoon per plant each day. Every word honored.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A full can on each. Empty the saucers afterwards, too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now you're specifying the dose. I'll empty the saucers on Sunday. You only made the watering daily; write that distinction down before your next holiday.

reason: Replace detachable teacher prefixes with corrections and influence claims that materially shape the specific pursuit, keeping B contributions causal.
